input: Reseed the patchy lawn before autumn sets in

gold.taskTitle: Reseed Patchy Lawn Before Autumn Arrives
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to overseed or reseed bare and patchy areas of their lawn before autumn weather makes conditions unsuitable.

questions.title: How large is the total patchy area to reseed?
questions.description: Understanding the square footage or approximate size helps determine how much seed and materials will be needed.

questions.title: What grass type currently grows in your lawn?
questions.description: Knowing the existing grass species ensures the new seed matches and blends in properly.

questions.title: What caused the bare patches in the first place?
questions.description: Identifying the root cause (pests, disease, foot traffic, shade, etc.) determines whether prep work is needed before seeding.

questions.title: What is your exact location or climate zone?
questions.description: Location determines the realistic autumn deadline and the best seed varieties suited to local conditions.

questions.title: Do you have existing lawn equipment like an aerator or spreader?
questions.description: Knowing what tools are already available shapes the approach and avoids recommending unnecessary purchases or rentals.

questions.title: What is your budget for this reseeding project?
questions.description: Budget influences choices around seed quality, soil amendments, tools, and whether professional help is considered.

questions.title: Are you doing this yourself or hiring someone?
questions.description: Clarifying whether this is a DIY effort or a managed job determines the type of action plan and steps to lay out.
